descriptions.static: clarity, sharpness, color accuracy, and overall aesthetic appeal of the video frames
descriptions.temporal: Temporal smoothness evaluates the temporal coherence of video frames and the absence of temporal artifacts such as flickering or jittering.
descriptions.dynamic: Dynamic degree evaluates the extent to which the video incorporates large motions and dynamic scenes, which contributes to the overall liveliness and engagement measurement of the content.
descriptions.text_video: Text-video (TV) correspondence assesses how accurately the video content reflects the details, themes, and actions described in the prompt, ensuring that the generated video effectively translates the text input into a visual narrative.
